widgetTool.name: acn-product-cards
widgetTool.description: Emit a row of information cards the customer can scroll and tap: account products and GIC terms, an account or investment summary, an application status tracker, a trip readiness checklist, or a shelf of things to explore. Each card has an optional badge, a big headline figure, a few key details and an optional button that sends a message back to you. Use real data only: never put a number on a card that did not come from a tool in this conversation. Before calling this tool, say your answer out loud in one or two sentences and ask one short question; never call it without speaking first.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-product-cards'

title.description: Heading above the cards, e.g. 'Everyday accounts' or 'GIC rates'.

subtitle.description: One short line under the heading.

variant.description: One of: rates, summary, status, checklist, shelf.

footnote.description: Small print under the cards, e.g. the CDIC notice.

title.description: Card name, e.g. 'High-Interest Savings' or '1 year'.

tone.description: Colour of the badge and card edge: positive, info, warning or negative.

headline_label.description: What the headline figure is, e.g. 'per year' or 'balance'.

details.description: Up to 6 key facts. For a checklist give done=true or false instead of a value.

cta_value.description: The message sent to you when the button is tapped, written as the customer would say it.
